_comment: Single source of truth for per-route SEO on the client-rendered (non-SSR) routes. Consumed at RUNTIME by src/lib/seoConfig.ts (useRouteSeo, after hydration) and at BUILD time by scripts/postbuild.js, which pre-renders one static HTML file per route into dist/ so crawlers get the right <title>/description/canonical/robots in the FIRST byte of HTML rather than only after JS runs. Keep additions here, not in either consumer.
